mapper.sql: driver_seq, driver_name, center_seq, login_id, password, ext_system_linked_id, driver_phone_num, email, driver_license_num, driver_license_date, driver_license_agency, comp_name, working_days, working_start_hour, working_end_hour, status_cd, created_at, creator_seq, modified_at, modifier_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE t_driver SET driver_name = #{driverName}, center_seq = #{centerSeq}, password = #{password}, ext_system_linked_id = #{extSystemLinkedId}, driver_phone_num = #{driverPhoneNum}, email = #{email}, driver_license_num = #{driverLicenseNum}, driver_license_date = #{driverLicenseDate}, driver_license_agency = #{driverLicenseAgency}, comp_name = #{compName}, working_days = #{workingDays}, working_start_hour = #{workingStartHour}, working_end_hour = #{workingEndHour}, status_cd = #{statusCd}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modifier_seq = #{modifierSeq} WHERE driver_seq = #{driverSeq}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.driver_seq, a.driver_name, a.center_seq, c.center_name, a.login_id, a.ext_system_linked_id, a.driver_phone_num, a.email, a.driver_license_num, a.driver_license_date, a.driver_license_agency, a.comp_name, a.working_days, a.working_start_hour, a.working_end_hour, a.status_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'DriverStatus' AND com_code_cd = a.status_cd) AS status_cd_name, a.creator_seq, b.admin_name AS creator_name, a.created_at FROM t_driver a LEFT JOIN t_admin b ON a.creator_seq = b.admin_seq LEFT JOIN t_center c ON a.center_seq = c.center_seq
AND a.driver_name LIKE '%' || #{driverName} || '%'
AND c.center_name LIKE '%' || #{centerName} || '%'
AND a.status_cd = #{statusCd}
